instructions.name: admin_update_player_stats
docs: Admin-only: directly update player stats. For gameplay use `update_player_stats_cpi`.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Admin authority — must match the selected Universe authority.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The player's wallet (used for PDA derivation, does not need to sign)

instructions.name: advance_action_slot
docs: Advance to the next action slot (called when roll succeeds)

instructions.name: close_inventory
docs: Close an Inventory account; rent refunded to its owner. Requires the
inventory to be empty — callers should `remove_item_from_inventory`
everything first. Player-to-player moves must use trade settlement.

instructions.name: close_player
docs: Close a dead player account and reclaim its rent to the owner. Every
preserved dead-equipment reference must be recovered first so no Items
claim can be stranded after the Player account disappears.

instructions.name: close_session_escrow
docs: Close a SessionEscrow account. Requires the tracked balance to be zero —
callers should `withdraw_from_escrow` first. Any residual lamports above
rent-exempt minimum are returned to the authority via `close = authority`.

instructions.name: create_inventory_for
docs: Create an inventory for another wallet - allows sender to pay for recipient's inventory
This is used when transferring items to a wallet that doesn't have an inventory yet

accounts.name: payer
docs: The payer who funds the account creation (e.g., the sender in a transfer)

accounts.name: owner
docs: The owner of the new inventory (doesn't need to sign)

instructions.name: create_item_to_inventory
docs: Create a new item via loot roll AND add it to inventory in one transaction
This combines the items::create_item CPI with adding to inventory
NOTE: Uses manual reallocation to avoid CPI lamport accounting issues

accounts.name: loot_authority
docs: Dungeon-program PDA signer authorizing this loot settlement. Its signer
privilege is propagated unchanged through the nested items CPI.

accounts.name: item_account
docs: The PDA is [b"item", universe, genesis_owner, item_id] under Items.

accounts.name: loot_config
docs: Loot config for generating the item

instructions.name: create_item_to_inventory_cpi
docs: Session-aware version: create item and add to inventory
Uses session signer as payer, validates via session account
NOTE: Uses manual reallocation to avoid CPI lamport accounting issues

accounts.name: session_signer
docs: Session signer - pays for account creation

accounts.name: loot_authority
docs: Dungeon-program PDA signer authorizing this loot settlement. Its signer
privilege is propagated unchanged through the nested items CPI.

accounts.name: session
docs: Valid session linking session_key to authority

accounts.name: item_account
docs: The PDA is [b"item", universe, genesis_owner, item_id] under Items.

accounts.name: loot_config
docs: Loot config for generating the item

instructions.name: create_player
docs: Create a player from the canonical enabled on-chain ClassConfig.

instructions.name: create_player_with_inventory
docs: Create a player and initialize or reuse their Universe-scoped wallet inventory.
This is the preferred creation flow for every character.

instructions.name: create_session
docs: Create a game session - allows a temporary keypair to act on behalf of the wallet authority
The session keypair can sign transactions without wallet approval popups
Parameters:
- duration_seconds: How long the session should last (max 24 hours = 86400 seconds)

accounts.name: session_key
docs: The temporary keypair that will sign transactions

instructions.name: deposit_to_escrow
docs: Deposit SOL into the session escrow
These funds can be used to fund session keypairs and are always recoverable

instructions.name: equip_item
docs: Remaining accounts must include the replaced item (if any), plus every
unchanged item's account and every final item's canonical ItemTypeConfig.
Item accounts whose membership changes must be writable; unchanged item
accounts and config accounts may be read-only. Order is irrelevant.

instructions.name: equip_item_with_session
docs: Session-aware item equip. Remaining-account requirements match `equip_item`.

instructions.name: extend_session
docs: Extend an existing session's expiry time

instructions.name: fund_session_from_escrow
docs: Fund a session keypair from the escrow
This transfers SOL from escrow PDA to the session signer
The session signer must sign to prove ownership of the keypair

accounts.name: authority
docs: The authority must sign to authorize the transfer

accounts.name: session_signer
docs: The session signer receives the funds

instructions.name: fund_session_signer_cpi
docs: Fund session signer from escrow via CPI (called by other programs)
Validates via session account instead of requiring authority signature

accounts.name: session_signer
docs: The session signer - must match session.session_key

accounts.name: session
docs: Valid session linking session_key to authority

accounts.name: escrow
docs: The escrow to fund from - must belong to session's authority

instructions.name: get_current_action
docs: Get the current action for the player

instructions.name: initialize_session_escrow
docs: Initialize a session escrow for the authority
This is a one-time setup that creates a PDA to hold session funds

instructions.name: recalculate_equipment_stats
docs: Recalculate all equipment stats by reading all equipped items and their
canonical ItemTypeConfigs from remaining accounts.

instructions.name: recover_dead_item_with_session
docs: Recover and destroy an item retained on an exact dead Player after death
removed it from shared inventory. Unlike junk removal, rarity is irrelevant.

accounts.name: player
docs: Canonical player used for live-equipment checks and exact dead-item
recovery. A dead player's preserved slot is also an authorization proof.

accounts.name: item_account
docs: mismatched accounts fail closed and never prune an inventory reference.

instructions.name: remove_lowest_rarity_item_from_inventory_with_session
docs: Session-aware item removal for lowest-rarity junk items.
If valid, closes the item account via items program and returns rent to session escrow.

instructions.name: reset_action_slot
docs: Reset action slot to the beginning (called at start of battle or after combat ends)

instructions.name: return_session_funds_to_escrow
docs: Return unused SOL from session keypair back to escrow
Call this before ending a session to recover funds

accounts.name: session_signer
docs: The session signer must sign to authorize returning funds

accounts.name: escrow
docs: The escrow to return funds to

instructions.name: revoke_session
docs: Revoke a game session - ends the session early
Only the original authority can revoke

instructions.name: set_action_enabled
docs: Enable or disable an action slot
Enforces MAX_ENABLED_ACTIONS limit (currently 3)

instructions.name: set_equipment_loadout
docs: Atomically replace the player's equipment with a full desired loadout.
Remaining accounts must include the union of current and desired item
accounts plus every desired canonical ItemTypeConfig. Added and removed
item accounts must be writable; unchanged items/configs may be read-only.

instructions.name: set_equipment_loadout_with_session
docs: Session-aware atomic loadout replacement. Remaining-account requirements
match `set_equipment_loadout`.

instructions.name: set_player_tags
docs: Replaces admin-authored player traits. Class and life-state tags remain derived.

instructions.name: swap_action_slots
docs: Swap two action slots

accounts.name: item_account
docs: Item account to be transferred - validated but owned by items program

accounts.name: items_program
docs: The items program that owns ItemAccount

instructions.name: unequip_item
docs: Remaining accounts must include the removed item as writable, plus each
surviving item's account and canonical ItemTypeConfig. Order is irrelevant.

instructions.name: unequip_item_with_session
docs: Session-aware item unequip. Remaining-account requirements match `unequip_item`.

instructions.name: update_player_stats
docs: Owner-signed gameplay stat update, authorized by the canonical Dungeon
program signer capability.

accounts.name: player_stats_authority
docs: Canonical Dungeon-program signer capability. Requiring both the PDA
address and signer privilege prevents arbitrary programs from relaying
owner signatures into this gameplay-only mutation boundary.

instructions.name: update_player_stats_cpi
docs: Session-authorized gameplay stat update. The session proves player
authority while the Dungeon PDA proves the caller is trusted gameplay.

accounts.name: player_stats_authority
docs: Canonical Dungeon-program signer capability. A valid session alone does
not authorize arbitrary programs to mutate gameplay stats.

accounts.name: session
docs: Valid session linking session_key to authority

instructions.name: withdraw_from_escrow
docs: Withdraw SOL from the session escrow back to the authority
This is always possible - funds are never locked

types.name: Action
docs: An action that can be used in combat

fields.name: tags
docs: Authored semantic traits. Structural source/effect tags are derived at use time.

fields.name: source_tags
docs: Effective traits of the concrete entity granting this action.
This is intentionally stored per action instead of on a combatant snapshot:
a silver weapon action must not make an unrelated helmet or class action
satisfy a source predicate requiring `material:silver`.

types.name: ActionConfig
docs: Action configuration for class defaults

types.name: ActionEffect
docs: Effects that can occur during combat from player actions

types.name: ActionSource
docs: Where an action comes from (innate class ability or equipment)

types.name: BattleLockTransition
docs: Exact ownership transition for the player's single outstanding battle lock.
A battle commit acquires the lock with its canonical account address. Only
the same commit may release it, which prevents one dungeon run from
unlocking a different run's pending reveal.

types.name: ClassConfig
docs: Configuration for a player class

types.name: ClassStatProfile
docs: Immutable class stat progression copied from the canonical ClassConfig when
a player is created. Keeping the snapshot on the player makes later class
balance edits apply only to newly created characters and avoids requiring a
mutable external config account on every level-up or equipment operation.

fields.name: universe
docs: Canonical GameContent Universe containing all of this player's state.

fields.name: class_stat_profile
docs: Class stat progression snapshotted at player creation.

fields.name: class_tags
docs: Class-config traits snapshotted at player creation.

fields.name: tags
docs: Authored player traits; entity/class/life-state tags are derived when evaluated.

fields.name: equipment_tag_rulebook
docs: Immutable TagRulebook that produced all cached equipment bonuses/actions.
The zero identity means the player currently has no equipped items.

fields.name: equipment_content_revision
docs: Mutable item/type content epoch used to derive the cached loadout.

fields.name: battle_lock
docs: Exact BattleCommit account that owns the pending battle lock. The zero
key means unlocked. Only that commit may release the lock during reveal
or forfeit, preventing another run from clearing it.

types.name: GameSession
docs: Game Session - allows temporary keypair to act on behalf of wallet authority
This enables auto-signing transactions without wallet approval popups

types.name: ItemSlot
docs: Equipment slots where items can be equipped

types.name: LootConfig
docs: Universe-wide loot roll configuration. Administrative authority is read
from the canonical Universe account so ownership transfers cannot leave a
stale controller duplicated here.

types.name: LootRollRequest
docs: Loot roll request parameters

fields.name: actor_tags
docs: Additional/effective role tags supplied by the authoritative caller.

types.name: PlayerClass
docs: Player character classes - determines abilities and stat growth

types.name: SessionEscrow
docs: Session Escrow - holds SOL that can be used to fund session keypairs
This is a PDA controlled by the authority, so funds are always recoverable
even if localStorage is lost (unlike the session keypair itself)

types.name: TagClauseV1
docs: One canonical fixed-capacity predicate clause.
The active prefix is nonzero, sorted, and unique. Unused slots must remain
zero-filled, preserving one deterministic wire representation per clause.

types.name: TagEffect
docs: A fixed-width rule result. Basis-point channels use 10_000 = 100%.

types.name: TagEffectChannel
docs: Orthogonal numeric channels produced by tag rules.

types.name: TagPredicateV1
docs: Allocation-free role predicate.
`required_all` must all be present. At least one `required_any` tag must be
present unless that clause is empty. No `forbidden_any` tag may be present.

types.name: TagRegistry
docs: Universe-scoped root for authority, custom-ID allocation, and rulebook activation.

fields.name: delegate_authority
docs: Optional tag-specific delegate. The zero key means no delegate.
Universe root/delegated admins are authorized independently of this role.

fields.name: equipment_content_revision
docs: Monotonic invalidation epoch for cached equipment state. Any mutation
to a concrete item's authored tags or canonical ItemTypeConfig bumps it.

types.name: TagRuleV1
docs: A bounded predicate for each role in the tag context.

types.name: TagRulebook
docs: A preallocated rulebook that becomes immutable once sealed.
Rules may be appended over multiple transactions until `seal` computes the
canonical digest and locks the account. Publishing a replacement creates a
new version whose `previous_rulebook` points to the formerly active account.

types.name: TagSetV1
docs: A fixed-capacity set stored as a strict ascending prefix and zero padding.
Deserialization cannot enforce semantic invariants, so account/argument
boundaries must call [`TagSetV1::validate`] (or a higher-level API that does).

types.name: TagStage
docs: Runtime boundary at which a tag rule may be evaluated.

fields.name: rulebook
docs: Immutable rules governing this trade, pinned when it is created.

types.name: Universe
docs: Stable root identity and authority boundary for one independent game world.
